Blocked: 10-10 digital (HTTP 406 to fetch), YO PSK31 (406, 2010 only), nine VHF sprints (sponsor unidentified), greyed items. Yield 3 of 27 index names (11%), 6 records.

Encoded: ALARA Contest, A1Club AWT. Matched: AGCW Straight Key Party to agcw-htp-80m/40m. Blocked: AWA events (no recurrence), Classic Exchange (PDF only), Balkan HF, the 10-10 contests (not on the sponsor's current schedule), VHF/UHF items (out of scope), and sponsors with no findable rules page. Yield 2 new live contests of 38 names (5%) -- but 17 of the 38 were VHF/UHF items closed by scope without a probe, so against the 21 HF names actually examined it is 2 (10%).
